setup: The parabola is in the form that opens along one axis.

steps.say: The sign of 4p decides the direction: positive opens one way, negative the other. Here 4p = [[four_p]].
In (x − h)² = 4p(y − k) the vertex sits at (h, k) and the curve opens vertically — up when p is positive, down when negative.
In (y − k)² = 4p(x − h) the vertex sits at (h, k) and the curve opens horizontally — right when p is positive, left when negative.
